d: Purniya ke nirdaliy sansad pappu yadav ne maner pulis enkauntar ko lekar rajy sarkar aur pulis prashasan par ganbhir saval khare kie hain. iske sath hi unhonne soniya gandhi ki aatmaktha (Belonging: A Journey of Love) par JDU-BJP ke virodh, bhajpa sansdon dvara kisanon par ki gaee vivadit tippani, aur desh ke aitihasik va samajik muddon par apni bebak ray rakhi.
